title: Implement the constrained local OCI-like importer and microvm run interface

test_results.output_excerpt: lib unit: 43 passed (error 7, platform 8, reference 5, manifest 7, config 8, spec 3, help 3, importer 1, +1) | local_import integration: 24 passed | 67 total, 0 failed

verification.cargo_test: pass (cargo test -p microvm-oci: 67 tests, 0 failures; cargo test --workspace: 56 test binaries report 'test result: ok', 0 failures, confirming the additive workspace member broke nothing)

acceptance_criteria.local_digest_pinned_manifest_imports_to_: local_import::local_import_produces_typed_microvm_spec builds a real local layout (manifest.json + blobs/sha256/<hex>) and asserts OciImporter::import() yields a MicroVmSpec with platform linux/amd64, guest_arch x86_64, digest-pinned kernel/rootfs LayerRefs (sha256, size, rel_path blobs/sha256/<hex>), a ResourceSpec translated from org.microvm.* labels (vcpu=2, memory=512, disk=1024, nat-only), and boot_args. import_is_deterministic_across_runs asserts byte-identical specs and serialization across runs.
acceptance_criteria.every_layer_hash_is_verified: importer.import_inner loops over ALL manifest.layers calling verify_blob (size check + constant-time verify_sha256) before mapping roles, and read_and_verify_config verifies the config blob digest+size. local_import::layer_digest_mismatch_is_rejected, config_digest_mismatch_is_rejected, layer_size_mismatch_is_rejected assert DigestMismatch/SizeMismatch (code digest_mismatch). every_layer_is_verified_even_unmapped_ones proves a third un-annotated layer with a bad digest still fails the import, so verification is not limited to kernel/rootfs. missing_blob_is_rejected asserts a declared-but-absent blob fails with artifact_not_found.
acceptance_criteria.unsupported_mounts_capabilities_host_net: config::scan_forbidden recursively scans the raw manifest+config JSON for an exact, case-insensitive forbidden-key set and returns a typed ImportError::Forbidden{field,key} (code permission_denied). local_import covers host_mounts_are_rejected (Mounts), capability_additions_are_rejected (Capabilities, incl. cap_add), privileged_mode_is_rejected (Privileged), host_network_is_rejected (HostNetwork, incl. network_mode=host), host_pid_and_ipc_are_rejected, arbitrary_host_process_controls_are_rejected (process/rlimits/sysctls/devices -> HostProcessControl), and forbidden_key_nested_deeply_is_rejected (linux.resources.devices). Remote URIs return ImportError::RemoteReference (code local_artifact_required) via reference::validate_local_reference; descriptor remote urls return ImportError::RemoteDescriptor.
acceptance_criteria.microvm_run_help_says_constrained_import: help::RUN_SHORT_ABOUT/RUN_LONG_ABOUT are the canonical run help source and explicitly state 'CONSTRAINED LOCAL IMPORT interface, not an OCI runtime' and 'does NOT provide OCI runtime compatibility'. help::tests::help_disclaims_oci_runtime_compatibility and local_import::run_help_says_constrained_import_not_oci_runtime assert the text contains 'constrained local import' and 'not an oci runtime' and never affirmatively claims OCI runtime compatibility/conformance/compliance. Crate-level lib.rs docs repeat the non-goal.
acceptance_criteria.no_remote_client_dependency_required: microvm-oci depends only on microvm-types/errors/artifacts + serde/serde_json (Cargo.lock adds no new external crate; no reqwest/oci-distribution/any network client). The importer performs no network I/O by construction: reference validation is purely lexical and runs before any layout I/O. local_import::remote_and_tag_references_are_rejected_without_side_effect rejects https://, http://, docker://, oci://, registry://, s3://, nginx:latest, ubuntu:22.04, repo/img@sha256:... with local_artifact_required and creates no artifact; no_remote_client_dependency_is_required asserts the failure code is local_artifact_required, never transport_error.
acceptance_criteria.platform_selection_linux_amd64_and_arm64: platform::Platform exposes LINUX_AMD64/LINUX_ARM64 and from_oci normalizes amd64/x86_64 -> X86_64 and arm64/aarch64 -> Aarch64, rejecting any other os/arch with ImportError::UnsupportedPlatform. local_import::arm64_platform_selects_aarch64, import_for_platform_enforces_match (PlatformMismatch on amd64-image-with-arm64-request), and unsupported_platforms_are_rejected (windows/amd64, linux/riscv64, linux/386, linux/s390x, darwin/arm64) cover selection.
acceptance_criteria.reject_remote_tag_only_references: reference::validate_local_reference accepts local paths and file:// (empty/localhost host) and rejects scheme://, bare remote scheme prefixes, '@' digest-pinned registry refs, and tag-only names. manifest descriptors carrying urls are rejected (RemoteDescriptor). Malformed digests (non-sha256 prefix, wrong hex length) are rejected as MalformedDigest before any blob resolution.
acceptance_criteria.must_not_claim_oci_runtime_compatibility: No public item, doc comment, or help string claims OCI runtime compatibility; lib.rs and help.rs state the opposite explicitly, and tests enforce the disclaimer and the absence of affirmative claims.

qa_scenario.happy: cargo test -p microvm-oci --test local_import -- local_import_produces_typed_microvm_spec builds a local digest-pinned layout and asserts the typed MicroVmSpec (kernel/rootfs digests+sizes+rel_path, ResourceSpec from labels, platform/arch, boot_args); open_reference_accepts_local_path_and_file_uri confirms both local reference forms import.
qa_scenario.failure: cargo test -p microvm-oci --test local_import -- host_mounts_are_rejected capability_additions_are_rejected privileged_mode_is_rejected host_network_is_rejected remote_and_tag_references_are_rejected_without_side_effect imports manifests/configs containing mounts, capabilities, privileged, host_network, or https:// and asserts typed rejection (permission_denied for forbidden fields, local_artifact_required for remote refs) with no artifact/VM side effect: the importer only reads/verifies local blobs and never writes an artifact or spawns a VM.

key_types.OciManifest: Constrained local OCI image manifest subset (schemaVersion must be 2; non-empty layers; config + layer OciDescriptors). from_json_bytes parses and validate_shape enforces the schema, well-formed sha256:<64 hex> digests, and rejects any descriptor carrying remote urls. Layers declare their guest role via the org.microvm.media annotation (kernel/rootfs).
key_types.OciDescriptor: OCI content descriptor (mediaType, digest, size, optional urls/annotations/platform). validated_digest() refuses remote urls (RemoteDescriptor) and parses the digest; media_role() reads the org.microvm.media annotation.
key_types.OciImporter: Constrained local importer anchored at a layout root via microvm_artifacts::PathResolver (descriptor-relative, no-symlink opens). open_reference validates a local reference string first; import()/import_for_platform() read manifest.json, verify the config blob and EVERY layer digest+size, scan for forbidden runtime keys, select the platform, derive resources from labels, and return a MicroVmSpec. Performs no network I/O; no remote client dependency.
key_types.MicroVmSpec: Typed import output: selected Platform, GuestArch, digest-pinned kernel LayerRef, digest-pinned rootfs LayerRef, validated ResourceSpec, and boot_args. LayerRef carries media, verified sha256, size, and the layout-relative blob path (blobs/sha256/<hex>) that opens only through the artifact resolver. Serde round-trips deterministically.
key_types.ImportError: Typed rejection reasons: RemoteReference, RemoteDescriptor, ManifestInvalid, ConfigInvalid, MalformedDigest, UnsupportedPlatform, PlatformMismatch, Forbidden{ForbiddenField,key}, DigestMismatch, SizeMismatch, BlobNotFound, MissingMedia, DuplicateMedia, InvalidResources, Artifact. Each maps to a stable ErrorCode (local_artifact_required / invalid_resource_spec / permission_denied / digest_mismatch / artifact_not_found) and converts losslessly to MicrovmError; implements std::error::Error.
key_types.ForbiddenField: Category of refused runtime knob: Mounts, Capabilities, Privileged, HostNetwork, HostPid, HostIpc, HostProcessControl. config::scan_forbidden matches an exact, case-insensitive key set recursively over objects and arrays (fail-closed), independent of nesting.
key_types.Platform: Supported guest platform (linux/amd64 or linux/arm64) with custom serde that validates on deserialize; from_oci normalizes arch synonyms and maps to GuestArch (X86_64/Aarch64).
key_types.MicroVmResources: Resource spec derived from org.microvm.* labels (vcpu, memory-mib, disk-mib, network, boot-args) with documented defaults; to_resource_spec() builds the validated microvm_types::ResourceSpec.
